name: Webform Promotion Code
description: Adds a Webform text element that validates a submitted promotion/voucher code against an admin-configured plaintext list.
project_description: "Webform Promotion Code" exposes a new Webform element called "Promotion code element". It renders as a plain text field on the form. When the form is submitted, the value the user typed is validated against a list of valid codes that the site builder entered (one per line) when configuring the element. Submissions whose code is not in the list are rejected with a validation error; submissions with a matching code (or an empty value, since the element is not required by itself) are accepted. The element config form includes a client-side "Auto generate" helper that fills the code list with N random codes of a chosen length and character set. The module stores codes in plaintext inside the Webform's element configuration, performs a simple case-sensitive in_array() membership check, and does NOT track redemption — a valid code can be reused on every submission unless the site builder separately enables Webform's built-in "Unique" value constraint. Common uses: gating an anonymous Webform behind an invitation/access code, adding a voucher or partner-discount field, or password-protecting a form. Requires the Webform module.
